findings.name: git_identity
findings.message: git has no user.name or user.email, so Checkpoints cannot be saved
findings.fix: git config --global user.name "Your Name" && git config --global user.email you@example.com

findings.name: local_state
findings.message: $HOME/study/.lamplight/state.toml is damaged, so study ignores it: toml: line 1 (last key "recent_topic"): expected value but found '\n' instead

findings.name: topic:c
findings.message: $HOME/study/c/topic.toml is not valid TOML: toml: line 1 (last key "title"): expected value but found "broken" instead
findings.fix: fix the file by hand, or restore it from the Topic's git history

findings.name: topic:physics
findings.message: $HOME/study/physics/topic.toml has format 99, but this version of study only understands format 1: upgrade study

findings.name: topic:go
findings.message: go is not a git repository, so Checkpoints cannot be saved

findings.name: library
findings.message: $HOME/study/.lamplight/library.json was written by a newer version of study
findings.fix: upgrade study, or rebuild the index with study library build <folder>

findings.name: log
findings.message: STUDY_LOG="verbose" is not a level, so study uses info
findings.fix: set STUDY_LOG to debug, info, warn or error

findings.name: setup
findings.message: no Claude Code or Codex found; other agents need an MCP server that runs study mcp
